narrative: Four high-severity contradictions require curator resolution before this run can be promoted to canonical: the IHC hospital count (75 vs. 36 — deep-research CONTRADICTED, not yet applied to body text), the Indonesia specialist deficit (65,000 vs. ~31,000 — CONTRADICTED, body text not updated), the Peka B40 NCD rate (41% vs. ~70% — CONTRADICTED, body text not updated in stage-2 while stage-5 already reflects the correction), and the SATUSEHAT 8.9% misattribution (vendor market share propagated as national integration rate across all six stages despite deep-research REFINED verdict). The four medium-severity items — Malaysia claims ratio 111% vs. 65.9% framing, VEDIKA scope (system-wide vs. single-hospital), POJK 36 designation (2025 vs. 2024, effective date Dec 2026 vs. Jan 2026), and the inconsistent geographic scope of the 8.9% SATUSEHAT figure — require correction but do not change the fundamental analytical conclusions of any stage.
